h:
已经过去 3 个月了，是时候...是时候推出新版本的 RAPID 工作流程了🥳！！！！

我有全新的巫术给你。

让我来告诉你一些重要的事情：

  1. 通过优化缓存路由，速度提高 10 倍，可快速生成批量图像。

  2. 工作流程注释现在有动画、按钮、链接，工作流程内还有一个菜单。

  3. 自定义提示语法是新的、经过改进的，现在可以正常使用。不存在边缘情况。我基本上构建了一个提示编译器，它使用自定义提示编程语言来编译提示语法（如果它变得比现在更复杂，我真的可能必须实现提示编译器的一些抽象语法树实现）。

  4. 一切都可以切换。

  5. 不再需要“!!UNDEFINED.safetensors”文件！您现在可以直接运行它。

  6. 以前版本的所有功能仍然存在，每个功能的实现都经过了大幅优化。我的意思是，非常非常。与之前占用的处理量相比，它们很小。

  7. 控制网就在这里！！在这里获取您的 controlnet 工作流程！顺便说一句，我正在使用这个控制网（https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-scribble-sdxl-1.0）以获取您看到的预览。

为什么没有 0.5.x 版本？

您可能想知道为什么没有 0.5.x 版本。嗯，关于这一点。总而言之，我改变了很多东西，以至于我不得不跳过 0.5.x 系列更新。现在，就上下文而言，0.5.x 更新的最后一个版本是版本 0.5.104。 0.5有104个版本！那么，为什么我要改为0.6呢？因为我发现某些东西需要大量更新，以至于我不得不更改版本。从长远来看，在 0.6.x 系列更新的第一个版本中，节点数量从超过 2000 个节点减少到不到 900 个。

为什么需要3个月？

下一个问题可能是，“为什么这次更新花了这么长时间？”好吧，尽管我想继续向工作流程添加功能，但它迫切需要优化。你猜怎么着，这主要是花了这么长时间的原因。我想找到优化的绝对极限，但以前不存在这样的壮举的例子。所以，我必须自己做。我查阅了无数的库，剔除了无数的节点，思考了无数的优化策略，做了太多的实验，所有这些都是为了几乎达到我可以在一周内达到的目标，如果我知道我现在在做什么的话。除此之外，我花了整整一个月的时间试图提出预览的想法，并在一天之内想出了所有这些想法。我真的不知道什么感觉 这。

最后注意事项：

好吧！我要说的就这么多了。抱歉这次更新拖了这么久！如果您想了解“为什么应该选择此工作流程？”这是：

“重要的不是这个工作流程中有 controlnet 功能，也不是有高分辨率或提示区域或自定义提示语法或 SD 和 SDXL 切换或注释或菜单等。而是真正的一切都在一次！一切都在一个地方！！而且它以尽可能最快的速度工作。”

感谢您使用工作流程！请反馈！我将很快根据收到的反馈数量进行另一次更新。我还将尝试自己发布帖子并将工作流程链接为工具。我忘记了那是我迄今为止可以做的事情。我想也期待看到其中的一些👍。

之前版本 v0.6.x：


你好！我终于分享了过去 5 个月我一直在努力的工作流程！它可以做很多事情并且具有很多功能：

  1. 使用适当的 HTML 注释，通过标记组和简短说明来组织工作流程。 （以后会更好看，只是现在没力气了。）

  2. 区域特定提示。 （受到“多个角色”工作流程的启发。）

  3. 随机提示。

  4. 自定义提示语法，允许在其他功能中进行评论。

  5. 保存时自动将 LoRA、检查点和所有其他提示生成信息添加到最终图像中。

  6. 能够在 SD 模式和 SDXL 模式之间切换。 （可能适用于 >=0.4.6 idk 的版本）

  7. 添加了一种在 SDXL 模型上工作的降噪方法。

  8. 输出到由您在“字符”和“版本”节点中放置的内容控制的自定义文件路径。

  9. 修复图像的能力。

  10. 能够将图像用作潜在图像。

  11. 具有可以随意启用或禁用的高分辨率。

  12. （新）从版本 0.4.6 开始详细说明管道！

这就是我现在能列出的全部内容。我计划将来添加更多功能。

！重要提示：创建一个名为“!!UNDEFINED.safetensors”的空文件并将其添加到您的 LoRA 文件夹中。工作流程使用它来检查空的或未定义的 LoRA，因此执行此操作非常重要！

o.en:
It's been like 3 months, and It's time... time for a NEW VERSION of the RAPID Workflow 🥳!!!!

I have brand new witchcraft for you.

Let me fill you in on the big stuff:

  1. 10x speed increase with optimized cache routing for lightning quick batch image generation.

  2. The workflow notes now have animations, buttons, links, and also there is a menu inside the workflow.

  3. The custom prompt syntax is new, improved, and now works in general. There are no edge cases. I basically built a prompt compiler that compiles your prompt syntax using a custom prompt programming language (I seriously might have to implement some abstract syntax tree implementation of the prompt compiler if it gets any more complicated than it is now).

  4. Everything can be toggled.

  5. No more "!!UNDEFINED.safetensors" file is needed! You can just straight up run it now.

  6. All the features from the previous version are still here, the implementation of each feature has been HEAVILY optimized. I mean, HEAVILY HEAVILY. They are TINY in comparison to how much processing they took up before.

  7. ControlNets ARE HERE!! Get your controlnet workflow RIGHT HERE! BTW, I'm using this controlnet (https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-scribble-sdxl-1.0) for the previews that you see.

Why no 0.5.x version?

You might be wondering why there is no 0.5.x version. Well, about that. The long and the short of it is that there were so many things that I changed that I had to skip the 0.5.x series of updates. Now, for context, the last version of the 0.5.x updates was version 0.5.104. THERE WERE 104 VERSIONS OF 0.5! So, why did I change to 0.6? Because I discovered something that required an update so massive that I had to change versions. For perspective, the node count went from over 2000 nodes to less than 900 in the FIRST VERSION of the 0.6.x series of updates.

Why take 3 months?

Next question probably is, "Why did this update take so long?" Well, for as much as I wanted to keep adding features to the workflow, it desperately needed optimization. And guess what, that's mainly what took so long. I wanted to find the absolute limit of optimization, but no previous examples of such a feat existed. So, I had to do it myself. I looked through endless amounts of libraries, culled countless nodes, thought of countless optimization strategies, did way too many experiments, all to pretty much get somewhere I could have reached in a week if I had known what I do now. Other than that, I spent a whole month trying to come up with ideas for previews and came up with literally all of them within a day. I really do not know how to feel about this.

Final Notes:

Alright! That is pretty much all I have to say. Sorry this update took so long! If you want a quote on "Why you should choose this workflow?" here it is:

"The big deal is not that there is controlnet capability in this workflow, or that there is highres or prompt regions or custom prompt syntax or SD and SDXL toggling or notes or a menu, etc. It's that there is LITERALLY EVERYTHING ALL AT ONCE! It's all IN ONE PLACE!! AND it works at the fastest speed possible."

Thank you for using the workflow! Please give feedback! I'll make another update pretty soon depending on how much feedback I get. I'll also try to make posts myself and link the workflow as a tool. I forgot that was even a thing I could do up until now. Look forward to seeing some of that too I guess 👍.

Pre-Version v0.6.x:


Hello! I'm finally sharing the workflow I have been working on for the past 5 months now! It can do a fair bit of things and has a fair bit of features:

  1. Organized workflow with labeled groups and short explanations using proper HTML notes. (They will look much nicer in the future, I just don't have the energy at the moment.)

  2. Region specific prompts. (Inspired by the "Multiple characters" workflow.)

  3. Randomized prompts.

  4. Custom prompting syntax that allows commenting among other features.

  5. Automatically adds the LoRA, the checkpoint, and all other prompt generation info to the final image on save.

  6. Ability to switch between SD mode and SDXL mode. (Might work for versions >=0.4.6 idk)

  7. Adds a way for denoise to work on SDXL models.

  8. Outputs to a custom filepath controlled by what you put in the "Character" and "Version" nodes.

  9. Ability to inpaint images.

  10. Ability to use an image as latent.

  11. Has HighRes that can be enabled or disabled at will.

  12. (NEW) Adetailing pipeline as of version 0.4.6!

That's about all I can list for right now. I plan on adding many more features in the future.

!IMPORTANT: Create an empty file named "!!UNDEFINED.safetensors" and add it to your LoRA folder. The workflow uses it to check for empty or undefined LoRA's so it's very important that you do this!
